title: The Salt Trail
author: Bram Halloran
blurb: Hazel Pemberton, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
